Select molecule ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human carbonic anhydrase I (CHEMBL261). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter to include only rows where canonical_smiles is not null. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending. Return columns aliased as molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
